sources.photometry: Approximate Johnson V = VT − 0.090(BT−VT), B−V = 0.850(BT−VT), exactly as catalogue ReadMe note7. Propagated random errors assume independent BT/VT; transformation systematic/color-range uncertainty is unreported, not zero.

preparation.method: HIP rows preferred by explicit Tycho HIP cross-ID; no spatial deduplication of possible resolved companions. First-order proper motion advances Hipparcos 1991.25 to epoch2000. Native coordinates and motions remain preserved per record.

limits: NOIRLab optical exposure dates are not published; 2020-06-30 is a release date, not an observation epoch. The catalogue is therefore epoch2000, never labelled exact photo-epoch astrometry.
No distance or nebular membership inferred from position; catalogue parallax retained without naive inversion.
Display brightness/color must come from apparent magnitudes/colour indices, not star-removal residual.
Named-star labels are optional identity metadata and not fabricated from brightness ordering.
